tasks.subject: TASK 1 — Orientation + coverage audit
tasks.description: Run suite, per-package coverage, identify least-tested paths, record audit in report early.

tasks.subject: TASK 2 — Code review pass across all packages
tasks.description: Read every package for defects: error handling, races, off-by-ones, lock ordering, resource leaks, protocol edges. Fix clear-cut ones; list judgment calls.

tasks.subject: TASK 3 — Test-coverage expansion
tasks.description: Add tests for control dispatch, serveWatch, watchCtl footers, notify.Beat, stall boundaries, job helpers, supervisor stop/finish/never-fork. Target >=70% per package.

tasks.subject: TASK 4 — Green gate
tasks.description: go vet clean, go test -race clean, gofmt -l empty.

tasks.subject: TASK 5 — Final report /tmp/supervisor-review_final_report.md
tasks.description: Findings, coverage before/after, test counts, SHAs, behavior changes, recommendations. End with SUPERVISOR_REVIEW_DONE.
